card.statement.raises a clean record’s limit by a fifth: A positive test of the six-monthly raise, with its control, played to the date: the limit is unchanged at the 20 February 2027 statement (180 days). At the 20 March statement it goes from $65,217 to $78,260 (a fifth, rounded to the dollar), cardRoom reads $78,260, and “It’s $78,260.00 now, for a clean record.” The card.set_auto_raise off twin keeps $65,217 with no notice. A reload sits in between. Until 2026-10-16’s brief 09 the notice’s apostrophe was a straight one.

documents.apply_idcard.PLAYER JOURNEY: every other photo ID los: Gap 1: a new bank takes the ID card, read by photoIdOf through bank.open_current (Citi), refused before the card and while it’s on its way, in its own words. Gap 2: the $28 fee checked twice, as the fall in the checking balance and as the transaction that took it. A citizen’s card comes by mail twenty business days on, Tuesday 22 September 2026, good to her birthday on 14 June 2034, given as literal dates, across a save and a load. Until 2026-10-17 a citizen’s card was in force at once, with a six-year term
